newsitem.title: FINLAND: M-Serla warning hits Finnish forestries.
newsitem.headline: M-Serla warning hits Finnish forestries.

text.p: Forestries extended losses in moderate trade on Tuesday afternoon after Finnish forestry group Metsa-Serla Oy warned it expected to fall into the red in May-December, brokers said.

At 1445/1145 GMT, the forest industry sub-index was down over two percent around 2,117 points after trading at around 2,137 before the profit warning. The HEX general share index was down 0.27 percent at 2,121.87 points.
Metsa-Serla's B share traded at 30.30 markka, down 1.40 markka or more than four percent, but was off lows.
UPM-Kymmene was down 2.50 markka or over two percent at 95.80 markka. Enso traded at 36.20 markka, down 0.90 markka or over two percent.
